sources.title: ChatGPT: Chat, Work, Create & Code with AI
sources.snippet: Use ChatGPT to answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code—all in one place. Get started for free or download the app.

sources.title: GitHub - xcapt0/gpt2_chatbot: ☕ GPT-2 chatbot for daily conversation
sources.snippet: GPT-2 chatbot for daily conversations trained on Daily Dialogue, Empathetic Dialogues, PERSONA-CHAT, Blended Skill Talk datasets. This chatbot is made based on GPT2 Model transformer with a language modeling head on top.

sources.title: GitHub - rskworld/gpt2-chatbot: This project implements GPT-2 for text ...
sources.snippet: This project implements GPT-2 for text generation and chatbot applications. GPT-2 uses autoregressive language modeling to generate coherent and contextually relevant text. The system includes fine-tuning for specific domains, conversation management, and response generation with temperature control for diverse outputs.

sources.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.0 - OpenAI
sources.snippet: ChatGPT Images 2.0 introduces a state-of-the-art image generation model with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and advanced visual reasoning.

sources.title: Gpt2-chatbot: The Mysterious New Model That's Baffling the AI Community
sources.snippet: Some have speculated that gpt2-chatbot could be a retrained version of OpenAI's original GPT-2 model - hence the naming convention - updated with modern datasets.
